summary: The Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Modernization Act of 2026 reauthorizes and updates housing programs under the Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Act of 1996 through fiscal year 2033. The bill modifies environmental review rules, rent and procurement policies, lease lengths, home loan guarantee programs, and establishes new grant programs focused on homelessness, supportive services, and housing assistance for American Indians, Alaska Natives, and Native Hawaiians.

affected_groups.effect: Gain increased self-determination authority to set local procurement and rent policies, submit consolidated annual performance reports, manage environmental reviews, and access new grant programs and loan guarantee improvements.
affected_groups.group: Indian tribes and tribally designated housing entities

affected_groups.effect: Receive reauthorized housing assistance, eligibility for expanded loan guarantees on fee simple lands, and access to a dedicated homeless housing assistance grant program.
affected_groups.group: Native Hawaiian families and the Department of Hawaiian Home Lands

affected_groups.effect: Are prioritized for new rental assistance and supportive housing services through targeted grant programs administered with mandatory case management.
affected_groups.group: Homeless or at-risk American Indian, Alaska Native, and Native Hawaiian veterans and youth

key_provisions: Reauthorizes appropriations for housing assistance programs under the Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Act of 1996 and Native Hawaiian housing assistance for fiscal years 2027 through 2033.
Streamlines and consolidates environmental review requirements, exempting certain minor activities and specific conditions from federal review.
Extends the maximum leasehold interest on trust or restricted lands for housing purposes from 50 years to 99 years.
Expands the Section 184 Indian Home Loan Guarantee program and Section 184A Native Hawaiian Housing Loan Guarantee program, including provisions for direct lender endorsement and periodic reviews.

Establishes new targeted grant programs including the Tribal HUD-VASH rental assistance program for homeless or at-risk Indian veterans, the Tribal Homeless Housing Assistance Grant Program, the Native Hawaiian Homeless Housing Assistance Grant Program, and the Tribal Continuum of Care Participation Grant Program.
Grants Indian tribes and tribally designated housing entities the authority to establish their own policies on rents, homebuyer payments, and procurement rules.
missing_information: Specific dollar amounts or exact funding ceilings for the reauthorized appropriations for fiscal years 2027 through 2033, as the text states 'such sums as may be necessary'.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Modernization Act of 2026 reauthorizes and updates housing programs under the Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Act of 1996 through fiscal year 2033. The bill modifies environmental review rules, rent and procurement policies, lease lengths, home loan guarantee programs, and establishes new grant programs focused on homelessness, supportive services, and housing assistance for American Indians, Alaska Natives, and Native Hawaiians.
summary_detail.significance: This bill reauthorizes and significantly modifies federal housing assistance for Native Americans and Native Hawaiians by reducing administrative and environmental review burdens, expanding home loan guarantees, and introducing targeted grant programs to combat homelessness and support vulnerable populations in tribal and Hawaiian communities.
